1.2. Principal activities and nature of operations
The principal activity of the Company is hoteliering and leisure related activities. There were no significant changes
in the nature of the principal activities of the Company during the financial year under review.
1.3. Parent enterprise and ultimate parent enterprise
There is no significant parent company and Company, has a related party relationship with its directors.
1.4. Number of employees
The number of employees of the Company at the end of the year was 58 (2024/25 – 64).
